description: This file defines the TargetRepository class responsible for database operations related to 'Target' entities, including finding, inserting, and searching targets within a MySQL database.

classes.name: TargetRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing 'Target' database records, implementing find, insert, search, and delete operations with MySQL.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieve a target record by its ID.

methods.name: findOrInsert
methods.description: Find a target by specific attributes or insert it if it does not exist.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Search for targets matching given criteria, with optional pagination.

methods.name: countSearch
methods.description: Count the number of targets matching given search criteria.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Delete a target record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert a new target record into the database.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Construct and return the base SelectQueryBuilder for target queries.
